reel.caption:
Encashing ₹50,000 of leave: how much of it goes to tax?

Leave encashed while you're still in the job is taxed as salary: illustrative ₹50,000 at a 20% slab + 4% cess = ₹10,400.
Encashed when you resign or retire, it's tax-free up to the least of: the amount paid, ₹25 lakh (lifetime, across all employers), 10 months' average basic + DA, and leave counted at most 30 days per completed year.
The exemption applies in both the old and new regimes. Your company's leave policy decides what you can carry forward.

Do you encash leaves every year or let them pile up?

Sources: a payroll-software academy guide (Aug 2026), an HR platform's leave-encashment guide (May 2026) and a tax-filing site's explainer; the ₹ figure is our own arithmetic.

For education only. Not investment advice.
